mascots.name: plex-s3fs-cloud-logo
mascots.prompt: Create the final standalone mascot logo for plex-s3fs with a much stronger Popcorn brand feel. The input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow soft creamy fluffy shapes, very expressive big happy glossy eyes, open smiling mouth, playful sculpted 3D illustration, warm cinema lighting and tactile premium indie developer charm. Do not copy the popcorn tub mascot or wordmark. Original project metaphor is CLOUD STORAGE + MOVIE LIBRARY. Design an adorable warm-cream fluffy CLOUD character with a face, emerging from an open midnight-blue rounded storage/archive box. The front of the box has one simple buttery-gold play triangle and a slim teal storage-status light. A little cloud arm holds a small coral-red and cream movie clapperboard on the right; a short gently curling filmstrip peeks from the box on the left. Cloud is soft clustered pillows, NOT popcorn kernels. Cloud dominates the silhouette with enormous joyful eyes and rosy cheeks; the dark storage box is its lower third. Small bright gold accent rays only close to body. Colors cream #FFF4D6, coral #F05B62, butter gold #FFCC4D, midnight #1C2230, muted teal #5EAD9B. Friendly, magical, tactile, smiling movie-night companion. No amber robot, no server face, no square TV. One isolated full-color mascot logo on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No letters, no words, no wordmark, no background tile, no ground shadow, no unrelated floating elements, no Plex corporate chevron or Amazon marks. Clear silhouette, generous transparent margin, high-end illustration matching reference polish.

No collage, no mockup frame, no corporate Plex/Amazon marks, no badges, no extra text, no URL. All artwork and text inside 6% margins, no clipped wordmark or limbs. Opaque background.

No amber robot. Input2 is strong STYLE reference only for Popcorn sculpted cream bubble lettering with coral/red dimensional outline, cheerful tactile 3D mascot, warm cinematic atmosphere, quality of playful indie developer identity. All panels original cloud mascot and exact plex-s3fs wordmark. Midnight #1C2230, coral #F05B62, butter #FFCC4D, cream #FFF4D6, small teal #5EAD9B highlights. Panels: large logo cover cloud mascot + cream coral-edged plex-s3fs wordmark; clear-space logo diagram; social-card application mascot left wordmark right; large exact tagline "Your media. No dense fake UI, no popcorn kernels/tub, no corporate Plex/Amazon marks, no unrelated shapes. Keep Popcorn feel but original cloud cinema identity.
